knowledge:
- key_parameters:
    - TFID: The Entrez GeneID of the transcription factor of interest, specified as a character string.
    - ChIP: A character vector of predicted TF bound genes from ChIPx data, sorted from most to least likely to be bound (typically based on peak caller rankings).
    - DB: A processed and normalized gene expression database in big.matrix format, where rows represent unique Gene IDs and columns represent samples.
    - GPL_id: The NCBI GEO platform ID (e.g., 'GPL1261') used to download all matching samples when building a custom database.
    - GSMfiles: A character vector of specific GSM sample IDs from NCBI GEO used to build a custom database (alternative to GPL_id).
    - SaveDir: The directory path where the downloaded and processed database files will be saved during database construction. Must be already created and empty.
    - SaveFile: The filename prefix for the output of the cleanDatabase function.
    - SavePath: The directory path where the cleaned database files will be saved.
- alternatives:
    - Pre-built databases (DB_GPL1261 for mouse, DB_GPL570 for human) from the ChIPXpressData package are highly preferred over building custom databases due to the extreme download and processing times (which can take up to 2 weeks for entire platforms).
- when_to_use:
    - Use this package when you have genome-wide TF binding data (ChIP-seq or ChIP-chip) but lack corresponding TF perturbation gene expression data, and want to identify which bound genes are most likely to be functional transcriptional targets.
- pitfalls:
    - The save directory specified in buildDatabase must be already created and empty before running the function.
    - Converting probe IDs to Entrez Gene IDs (or alternative gene IDs) is a manual step that must be performed by the user using appropriate annotation packages (e.g., mouse4302.db) after buildDatabase and before cleanDatabase.
    - The gene ID format of the ChIP input vector must exactly match the row name format of the DB database (default is Entrez GeneID).

workflows.name: rank_targets_prebuilt_db
workflows.intent: Rank predicted TF bound genes using a pre-built gene expression database from the ChIPXpressData package.
input: Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes (dataframe containing ranked ChIP-seq predicted target genes with EntrezID column)
DB_GPL1261.bigmemory.desc (descriptor file for the pre-built mouse GPL1261 big.matrix database)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the ChIPXpress and ChIPXpressData packages ;; 2. Attach the pre-built big.matrix database using attach.big.matrix ;; 3. Run ChIPXpress with the TF Entrez ID, the ranked ChIP target Entrez IDs, and the attached database ;; 4. Map the ranked output back to gene symbols using the original annotation data.
workflows.code:
library(ChIPXpress)
data(Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes)
head(Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes)
library(ChIPXpressData)
library(bigmemory)
path <- system.file("extdata",  package="ChIPXpressData")
DB_GPL1261 <- attach.big.matrix("DB_GPL1261.bigmemory.desc", path=path)
Output <- ChIPXpress(TFID="18999",ChIP=Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes$EntrezID,DB=DB_GPL1261)
head(Output[[1]])
head(Output[[2]])
GeneNames <- Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes$Annotation[match(names(Output[[1]]),
                                          Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes$EntrezID)]
Result <- data.frame(1:length(Output[[1]]),GeneNames,names(Output[[1]]),Output[[1]])
colnames(Result) <- c("Rank","GeneNames","EntrezID","ChIPXpressScore")
head(Result)

workflows.name: build_custom_database
workflows.intent: Build, annotate, clean, and normalize a custom gene expression database from NCBI GEO raw data for use in ChIPXpress.
input: GPL_id (NCBI GEO platform ID) or GSMfiles (vector of specific GSM sample IDs)
mouse4302.db (annotation package for mapping probe IDs to Entrez Gene IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Download and process raw CEL files from GEO using buildDatabase ;; 2. Manually map probe IDs to Entrez Gene IDs using platform-specific annotation packages ;; 3. Resolve multi-mapped probes and normalize the database using cleanDatabase ;; 4. Run ChIPXpress using the newly created custom database.
workflows.code:
library(bigmemory)
library(biganalytics)
library(ChIPXpress)
library(GEOquery)
library(affy)
library(frma)
library(mouse4302frmavecs)

DB <- buildDatabase(GPL_id='GPL1261',SaveDir=tempdir())

GSM_ids <- c("GSM24056","GSM24058","GSM24060","GSM24061",
             "GSM94856","GSM94857","GSM94858","GSM94859")
DB <- buildDatabase(GSMfiles=GSM_ids,SaveDir=tempdir())

library(mouse4302.db)
EntrezID <- mget(as.character(rownames(DB)),mouse4302ENTREZID)
rownames(DB) <- as.character(EntrezID)

cleanDB <- cleanDatabase(DB,SaveFile="newDB_GPL1261.bigmemory",
                         SavePath=tempdir())
head(cleanDB)

out <- ChIPXpress(TFID="18999",ChIP=Oct4ESC_ChIPgenes,DB=cleanDB)
head(out[[1]])
head(out[[2]])

cleanDB <- attach.big.matrix("newDB_GPL1261.bigmemory.desc",path=tempdir())
head(cleanDB)
